author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Gareth Williams Thank you so much for your advice . Role play is a completely new idea for me, and it really sounds very helpful. I really appreciate you sharing this method 🙏  

Pronunciation is quite difficult for me, and it’s very different from my native language. After practicing, my throat sounds have improved a lot, but the  Tsadi (צ) sound is still something I can’t fully get right even until today 😂
